newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas forward months slip slightly but thin.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas forward months slip slightly but thin.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures were little changed by early afternoon on Wednesday although forward periods eased slightly in thin trade.
A total of 75 lots traded in November, December and March mostly slightly below Tuesday's close.

November traded twice at 12.500 pence per therm compared to Tuesday close of 12.515. December was unchanged trading at 13.750 pt while March next year traded at 13.900 pt, down 0.150 on Tuesday close.
July, the nearby month, was asking 9.350 pt the same as Tuesday close and some brokers expressed surprise at seeing any sign of weakness on the front end of the market.
"The warmer weather might have hit the off-take (of gas) but the OTC market is reasonably good and may go a bit higher," said a broker.
